snapshot_interfaces.tmutil_localsnapshot_scope: APFS volumes included in a Time Machine backup

review.sol_decision: A live APFS snapshot is a valid alternative source-view architecture. Qualify the method, privilege, space/retention budget, writer ownership/quiescence, and capture gates read-only before any creation. No source action is currently justified.

limitations: The APFS creation method and interactive admin flow remain unqualified; command help is not an execution rehearsal.
The available Data space does not establish a safe capture/retention budget or churn bound.
Launchd label and cwd counts are point-in-time observations and do not establish writer ownership, an atomic cutoff, or quiescence.
A Data snapshot would not qualify Kingston K, owner/protected closure, clean-host restore, or application completion semantics.
